packageRules.description: No minimum release age for trusted internal Terraform modules
Require manual approval for Terraform updates

Auto-merge non-major updates to Contentful's own Terraform modules. These are semver'd and internally owned, and a patch bump is the review nobody performs meaningfully. Majors still fall through to the manual-approval rule above. The 1-day minimumReleaseAge overrides the null set for these modules further up: with automerge:false that null was harmless, but auto-merging a version published seconds ago leaves no window to catch a bad release. Majors keep the null, so a deliberate rollout is still immediate.

Auto-merge non-major tflint and tflint ruleset updates. Lint-only: these cannot change infrastructure, so the worst case is a noisy lint job rather than an unwanted apply. Covers both the tflint-plugin manager and the tflint binary version managed by updateTflint. Providers are deliberately NOT auto-merged: a green plan means the config is valid, not that the diff is desirable, and consumers differ in whether merging to main applies to production.
